translations.en: Lit from behind, the temple cast a faint shadow toward you.
Beyond that, there were not even any pillars around it.
What was the clue pointing to?
"Honor the god and take three steps back"...
Use the key on the shadow at your feet
Insert the key into the temple
Put your head on the floor and spin
You paid your respects to the god and took three steps back,
then timidly tried inserting the key
into the temple's shadow at your feet.
The shadow stretched across the rubble-strewn ground.
A keyhole lay hidden within it,
quietly waiting for a key to turn.
You slowly tried turning the key.
It turned with your hand
and made a clicking sound.
It opened?! What was hidden inside?
From the box that opened within the shadow,
you retrieved a bronze @3rfrog statue@0r and a sheet of parchment.
That's all...? W-wait. Let me see that parchment.
You handed the parchment to @7rBeatrix@0r,
who stared intently at it.
Close the gate. Let it not be opened.
Should the gate nevertheless be thrown open, afterward
use this seal to close it. Seal the gate fast and firm.
What... Afterward...? Then this is...
We're meant to use it after the last seal is broken...?
But if the seal is broken, it'll all be pointless...
Her hands trembling, @7rBeatrix@0r
sank to the ground in disbelief.
The seal could not be repaired until it had first been broken.
Given that revelation, her reaction was only natural.
B-but we've found a safeguard in case the seal is broken.
That's how we should think of it.
Though @7rBeatrix@0r still looked anxious,
she spoke as if trying to encourage you.
Come on. Let's go back.
I'll pay your reward once we reach the tavern.
Nothing about the temple had changed.
That must have been the wrong approach.
You needed to think about what the clue meant.
The only thing resembling a box around the temple
was the long shadow it cast.
Presumably, doing something to that shadow would open a box.
If so, you ought to try various things
before this glowing phenomenon settled down.
Now, what was the right way to unlock it?
You could see dark, metallic ore gleaming between the walls.
When you took hold of the ore,
it came free more easily than you expected.
You obtained @3rIron Ore@0r.
You put the @3rIron Ore@0r in the bottom of your bag.
It was rather heavy, but you would manage.
When the mist cleared, an item lay on the ground.
You obtained the @3rClaw Wind@0r.
Your inventory was full,
so you decided to leave the item behind.
You have come quite far inside.

Let's search the area.

You could smell a beast.
There was something at your feet.
They seemed to be the tracks of a large beast.
The tracks of a large beast continued far into the depths.
Something lay on the ground at your feet.
